decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of disruption and removal to control the board and pressure the opponent. It aims to quickly deploy threats like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, while using cards like Duress, Fatal Push, and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate card advantage and maintain pressure. With a strong mana base and a variety of threats and answers, this deck looks to close out games efficiently while keeping the opponent on the back foot.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful removal spells. By utilizing cards like Archfiend of the Dross, Bloodtithe Harvester, and Unstoppable Slasher, the deck aims to deal quick and efficient damage to the opponent. The inclusion of Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Duress provides disruption to control the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful lands like Mutavault and Blackcleave Cliffs to help maintain board presence and deal consistent damage. Overall, the deck focuses on applying relentless pressure to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a combination of powerful creatures and efficient removal spells in the Rakdos color combination. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with threats like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester, while using cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of versatile spells like Duress and Blade of the Oni adds flexibility to the deck, allowing for both proactive and reactive strategies. With a strong mana base and a mix of threats and disruption, this deck seeks to consistently put pressure on opponents and maintain control of the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost creatures, including spirits, to establish a fast tempo while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counter spells and creature removal. By efficiently deploying threats and protecting them with evasion and disruptive cards, the deck aims to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. This aggressive strategy is supported by a mix of card advantage and control elements to maintain pressure and stay ahead in the tempo game.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Valgavoth, Terror Eater. The deck also includes various support cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The combination of these cards allows for explosive plays and synergies that can overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. The deck's goal is to use its creativity and unique combos to outmaneuver and outmatch the opponent in order to achieve victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester to control the board and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of efficient creatures, disruption, and land support, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and assert dominance in the early game.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient Spirit creatures in combination with disruptive instants and enchantments to maintain control of the board and pressure the opponent. By leveraging the tempo advantage provided by cards like Spell Queller and Rattlechains, the deck aims to quickly establish a strong battlefield presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Mutavault and Mausoleum Wanderer provide additional utility and flexibility, allowing for adaptable and dynamic gameplay. The inclusion of countermagic and removal spells further supports the aggro strategy, ensuring that the deck can efficiently deal with threats and maintain its tempo advantage.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful control tools to disrupt opponent's strategies while generating card advantage and maintaining board presence. With a solid mix of counter spells, card draw, removal, and versatile threats, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and grind out victories through incremental advantages. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value and versatility in longer games, further solidifying the deck's ability to control the pace of the game and come out on top in the late game.

The main concept of this Control - Enigmatic Incarnation deck is to utilize Enigmatic Incarnation to constantly tutor for powerful creature threats, while also using Leyline Binding and Nowhere to Run to control the opponent's board. The deck's aim is to overwhelm the opponent with a variety of powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Linvala, the Preserver, supported by cards like Spara's Headquarters and Fatal Push to maintain board presence. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds extra value by flickering key cards for additional advantage.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on using creatures with haste and damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes some protection spells to keep your creatures safe and push through damage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides an additional mana source to help cast your spells efficiently. The key strategy is to play aggressively, using the various creatures and spells to deal damage quickly and secure a win before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control win condition. It utilizes a variety of multicolor spells to draw cards, remove threats, and generate value. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexibility in accessing powerful spells while maintaining a consistent mana base through triomes and various lands. The sideboard companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, adds additional value with its flicker ability, providing extra card advantage and resilience. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through removal, card advantage, and powerful multicolor spells to outvalue and outlast opponents.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to play low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Questing Druid to deal damage early, while also using burn spells like Burst Lightning and Thud to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds extra versatility to the deck. By maintaining a fast-paced, aggressive playstyle, this Gruul Aggro deck aims to close out games before the opponent can establish their own strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix for repeated attacks. It includes plenty of cheap cantrips and removal spells to help trigger the Phoenix's ability. The deck also includes a mix of lands to ensure it has the right colors of mana available, as well as some utility cards like Ledger Shredder and Picklock Prankster to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and aggressive creatures.

This Rakdos Aggro deck is focused on using aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck seeks to apply pressure early on with cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck's mana base is designed to support its heavy black and red mana requirements, allowing for consistent and powerful plays throughout the game. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through aggressive creature beats and targeted removal.

The main focus of this deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent with early aggressive creatures like Faerie Miscreant and Moon-Circuit Hacker, coupled with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Deep-Cavern Bat provide additional threats and utility to help close out the game quickly. The deck also includes a small artifact package with Ornithopter and Spyglass Siren to support the aggro strategy. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggression and disruption.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and efficiently cast spells to enable the Arclight Phoenix to return from the graveyard to the battlefield. The deck includes numerous cheap spells like Opt, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe, as well as card draw and filtering cards like Consider and Sleight of Hand. By chaining together spells and using cards like Artist's Talent and Picklock Prankster, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and attacks, ultimately winning through aggressive plays and card advantage.
